0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Brooklyn Nets host the Charlotte Hornets, with Joshua Jefferson out for Brooklyn because of his back and Charlotte listing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel, Kylan Boswell and Moussa Diabate as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 victory over the Nets in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Nets a 40% chance to win.
